TaskStartService: Start the service right after installing
StatusInstallService: Registering the Windows service and installing drivers (ViGEmBus, HidHide)...
AskPurgeData: Also delete all OpenStreamMS data?%n%nSessions, seats and settings; the osms- users of isolated sessions and their profiles (including games and settings saved in them); stream profiles, ProgramData\OpenStreamMS and temporary files.%n%nIf you answer No, sessions and settings are kept for a reinstall.
AskRemoveDeps: Also uninstall ViGEmBus and HidHide?%n%nAnswer No if other applications use them.
MultiSessionNotice: OpenStreamMS no longer installs TermWrap or any other tool that allows several Windows sessions at once. If one is already on this PC, it stays: OpenStreamMS does not remove it.%n%nOfficially, several Windows sessions at once are only supported on Windows Server with the Remote Desktop Session Host role and RDS user CALs.%n%nOn Windows Home or Pro, using a third-party tool for this is your decision and your responsibility: it may not be permitted by the Windows license terms. OpenStreamMS only checks whether the PC allows it.
WindowsTooOld: OpenStreamMS needs Windows 10 version 1607 (build 14393) or later.%nThis PC has build %1. Update Windows and run the installer again.
